plain: Called by someone in authority to come or appear, as to a court

webster.text: Admonished or warned by authority to appear or attend to something; called or cited by authority.

example.quote: Criminals are brought, in this state, from every part of the country to the general court, and jurors from the vicinage are summoned to the trials.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 17, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
